content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-148","Title":"SessionLog.SubmitAsync returns 500 when beginTurn persists a superseded hook turn","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["Hostile beginTurn for session GrokCode-20260817T223446Z-hostile-new-session-add-profile tried to persist superseded hook turn req-20260817T222446Z-prompt-5e8b as canceled. Invoke-ReplSupersedeCurrentTurnIfInProgress calls Invoke-ReplPersistTurn, which POSTs a one-turn whole-session payload through client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync. The server returned method_invocation_error / internal_server_error (McpServerException). Failsafe 20260817T223450Z-session_submit-99db.yaml drained 5 times with the same error and was quarantined. Same class as implementer report triage-report-36e67f2973d44b1d8ad78515afaab7f6 (failsafe 6f9c, turn req-20260817T220643Z-prompt-dd78). The 6f9c payload is small and has no queryTitle, so the 500 is not unique to the large hostile prompt or raw-title path. SessionLogController.SubmitAsync has no typed catch; unhandled exceptions become opaque 500s. beginTurn still proceeds after a stderr warning, so the superseded hook turn is lost from the durable session log.","Triage group: triage-group-28e37ac6239a9278","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- workflow.sessionlog.beginTurn that supersedes an in-progress hook turn (req-*-prompt-*) persists that turn on the current session without client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync returning method_invocation_error or internal_server_error","- A later sessionlog query for the current session returns the superseded requestId with status canceled (or an equivalent terminal superseded status) and a response stating it was superseded by the new requestId","- The persist failsafe for that superseded turn is cleared after a successful write and is not quarantined after the drain budget","- If the superseded-turn payload is invalid, SessionLog returns a 4xx validation problem that names the failing field; it does not return an opaque 500 internal_server_error","Implementation notes:","- Reproduce from plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1: Invoke-ReplSupersedeCurrentTurnIfInProgress -\u003E Invoke-ReplPersistTurn -\u003E client.SessionLog.SubmitAsync. The persist body is a full UnifiedSessionLogDto with turnCount 1 and only the superseded turn.","- Server path is POST /mcpserver/sessionlog (SessionLogController.SubmitAsync -\u003E TransactionGatedSessionLogService.SubmitAsync -\u003E SessionLogService.SubmitAsync). Unique index is (SessionLogId, RequestId), so a hook requestId should insert as a new turn on the newly opened session.","- Prefer persisting the superseded turn with UpsertTurnAsync instead of a one-turn whole-session SubmitAsync. If SubmitAsync stays, catch service exceptions in the controller and return a typed problem details body instead of the global 500 mapper.","- Sibling evidence: F:\\GitHub\\TruckMate\\.mcpServer\\grok\\failsafe\\quarantine\\20260817T223450Z-session_submit-99db.yaml and 20260817T221136Z-session_submit-6f9c.yaml. Drain last error is identical: SessionLog.SubmitAsync / McpServerException / internal_server_error.","- 99db also sent queryTitle equal to a truncated raw prompt first line. Resolve-ReplSupersedeTitle is supposed to omit raw defaults (TR-MCP-REPL-015 / TR-MCP-REPL-019), but 6f9c failed without a title, so title handling is a follow-on hygiene issue, not the sole 500 cause."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
